question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The rules of behaviour which guide one in a formal situation
solution:
The correct answer is: **Protocol**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Protocol"** refers to the rules of behavior or etiquette that guide individuals in formal situations. (औपचारिक स्थितियों में मार्गदर्शन करने वाले नियम)

 
 
• **Example:** The ambassador followed the protocol while meeting with the head of state.
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** In formal settings, "protocol" ensures that individuals adhere to established rules and display appropriate conduct. (औपचारिक सेटिंग्स में, "प्रोटोकॉल" व्यक्तियों को निर्धारित नियमों का पालन करने और उपयुक्त आचरण प्रदर्शित करने में मदद करता है।)
 
 
• **Example:** It is essential to understand the protocol before attending an international conference.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Protocol**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Affidavit** (शपथपत्र): A written statement confirmed by oath or affirmation, for use as evidence in court.

 
 
• **Example:** She submitted an affidavit to prove her identity in the legal case.
 
 
 
• **Bargain** (सौदा): An agreement between two or more parties as to what each will do for the other.
 
 
• **Example:** We struck a bargain to buy the car at a discounted rate.
 
 
 
• **Impropriety** (अनुचितता): A failure to observe standards or show due honesty or modesty; improper behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** The committee investigated the allegations of impropriety in the organization.
